descriptionChirho: A visible indicator, portent, or miraculous act serving as evidence of divine power or a message from God, including the plagues of Egypt and other wonders.
A distinguishing mark or token that serves as a reminder or pledge of a covenant or agreement, such as the sign of circumcision or the rainbow as a sign of the Noahic covenant.
A military or tribal standard used to identify and rally a group, as in the ensigns of the Israelite tribes in the wilderness encampment.
